about: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech voices for the prologue's speakers (tools/voice/google_tts.py). Per speaker the voice in each language, its speakingRate, the pause in seconds that a '…' inside a line becomes, and the candidates the sampler (google_tts.py --sampler) plays. Speakers not listed here keep their Windows SAPI stand-in (placeholders.py). A speaker's preset variants (bob-radio) use the speaker's voice. A recording in tools/voice/recordings always wins.
